record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical relativity
record.original_question: Is there an Einstein-Yang-Mills analogue of the Majumdar-Papetrou superposition of extremal Reissner-Nordstrom solutions?

evidence.quote: (v) find an EYM generalisation of the Majumdar-Papetrou superposition of extremal RN solutions [HH];

artifact.self_contained_problem:
In Einstein–Maxwell theory, the Majumdar–Papapetrou family provides static, asymptotically flat solutions describing the gravitational and electrostatic superposition of an arbitrary number of extremal Reissner–Nordström black holes held in equilibrium: in suitable coordinates the metric and electromagnetic potential read
  g = -U^{-2} dt^2 + U^2 (dx^2 + dy^2 + dz^2),  A = U^{-1} dt,
where U: R^3 \ {p_1,...,p_N} -> R is any positive harmonic function on Euclidean R^3 of the form U(x) = 1 + sum_{i=1}^N m_i / |x - p_i|, with arbitrary positive masses m_i and arbitrary distinct centers p_i in R^3. These solve the source-free Einstein–Maxwell equations and represent multiple extremal charged black holes in static equilibrium.

Now consider the Einstein–Yang–Mills (EYM) system with a compact non-abelian gauge group G (for instance G = SU(2)): a Lorentzian 4-manifold (M, g) together with a connection A on a principal G-bundle over M, with curvature F = dA + A ∧ A, satisfying the coupled equations
  Ric(g) - (1/2) R(g) g = 8π T(F),    D ⋆ F = 0,
where T(F) is the Yang–Mills stress–energy tensor.

Question: Does there exist an Einstein–Yang–Mills analogue of the Majumdar–Papapetrou superposition? More precisely, do there exist static, asymptotically flat solutions of the Einstein–Yang–Mills equations (with non-abelian gauge group) describing the equilibrium superposition of an arbitrary number of extremal black holes located at arbitrarily prescribed points of space, parameterized by a multi-center harmonic-type function in analogy with the abelian Majumdar–Papapetrou family?
artifact.status_search_result: A web search returns related work on Majumdar–Papapetrou solutions coupled to non-abelian monopoles in Einstein–Yang–Mills–Higgs theory, and on single-copy/self-dual Yang–Mills relations to multi-center solutions, but no clear construction of a genuine multi-black-hole EYM superposition analogous to Majumdar–Papapetrou with a non-abelian gauge field alone (no Higgs) was identified. The status appears to remain unresolved in the literature found.

status_evidence.title: Gravitational magnetic monopoles and Majumdar-Papapetrou stars
status_evidence.snippet: Majumdar-Papapetrou-type configurations have been generalized to non-Abelian monopoles in Einstein-Yang-Mills-Higgs systems.
status_evidence.claim: Generalizations exist in the EYM-Higgs setting, but not in pure EYM.

status_evidence.title: Weyl-Lewis-Papapetrou coordinates, self-dual Yang-Mills equations and the single copy
status_evidence.snippet: Single-copy prescriptions relate gravitational solutions (including extremal Reissner-Nordström) to Yang-Mills solutions, but do not construct EYM multi-black-hole superpositions.
status_evidence.claim: No direct EYM Majumdar-Papapetrou analogue is constructed.
